Actual: SECRET_DETECTED, because internal/secretscreen's JWT rule matches any three dot-joined runs of 10+ characters. Evidence: the first fixture alias in internal/tasks/cli/obligations_migration_test.go; recorded as a TOL failure-mode row and in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-v1-1649-obligation-migration.md. Suspected wider impact on other dotted identifiers screened by the same rule.
